book.name: 1 CORINTIOS
book.title: 1 CORINTIOS Nacharam ẽsap Pabloou Corintopienag phã deepʉ̈itarr

content: Jãga aju aai nʉ jãg sĩi parhooba thʉnʉm khʉʉn dʉ̈i
Jaau nʉm khʉʉn iek mag pãar ee ãbmua ich bãaurr ũanpaita ich ʉʉikha wai sim anʉm. Jãgʉm pãar dak nem wajaphampa, jãgʉm pekau chan ni Ẽwandam iek khaugbam khʉʉn eejã ooba aajem.
Mag nʉmta pãrau pãachdëupain Ẽwandam iek wajapha ʉ̈kha nʉm aajerram. Mag iekhaju khãai warag pãar chigaa aju aai nʉmta, chigaa khabamjö nʉm. Chi mag sim wounan warre pãach eemua jʉrpʉ̈iju aaita sim.

Mʉ chan chadcha khĩircha chan pãar aar khaba chirʉm, mamʉ mʉchchata pãar aar chirʉmjö mʉch iekta maach Pör Jesucristo iek gaai thʉwi mua warre pãrag jaaukhim. Mua oowain jãgʉm khʉʉn dʉ̈in magta aju aai sim.

Pãar cha mua jaau chirʉm iek iekhaag ãba biirdʉawai khĩircha chan pãar aar khaba chirajup mamʉ mʉ akharan pãar aar sĩeju. Mag mʉchta pãar aar chirʉmjö chirʉm dʉ̈i ĩchab maach Pör Jesús i jua theegjã pãar dʉ̈i sĩeju.

Mag wajapha iekhawian chadau chi mag ich bãaurr ũan dʉ̈i sĩerr woun warre pãach eemua jʉrbapʉ̈it, dösãtagta i dʉ̈i ichdëu ampierr amkhĩir. Magbaawai ãsie ich daujã merag phëwia deeu ewag phʉʉrbawia ubʉ sĩsimʉn, maach Pör Jesús bëem edjã ʉ̈u i akhaardam peerdʉ auju.

Pãar ee jãg khaigba nʉm chan, pãachta wajapha nʉm awia pãrau pöd pãach thö iyʉ̈ʉ aju khaba nʉm. Jãgbaadëphʉmjã sĩi oobamjö bʉ̈ʉrjã iekhaba ich jãg sĩsiu akhiin, ãbpai mag sim gaaimua warag tagam khʉʉnpata ãrju, levadura bʉchkhun arin ee pʉ̈ibarmua warre thum aaidʉ joopjemjö.

Pãrau khaphʉm, phiesta Pascua ee paawai levadura thum barkhʉʉijem. Ich agjö khabahab Cristo meetarr gaaimua maach khaibag chugpaa athamjã. Mag sĩewai mag levadura dënjö pãach thumaam khʉʉn ãrpi sim woun warre pãach eemua chawag jʉrbapʉ̈it. Mag jʉrbapäaiwain chadau Pascua ee khoog pan levadura chukhu wau simjö pãar eejã mag khaigba nʉrrjëem gaaimua levadura dënjö bigaaum khʉʉnpa ãrpiju khʉʉn chukhu aju.

Mag phiesta Pascua ee aajemjöta maach Ẽwandam dʉ̈i wënʉrraju aai nʉm. Wajapcharan dich khaibag thum isegwia ãba khĩirjug wajapham auwia chadam iek gaai jaau simjö wënʉrrʉmʉn, pan levadura chukhu wau simjöta nʉm. Pari magba agtha dich khaigba nʉm khaphʉ nʉmjã isegba ich mag wai wënʉrrʉmʉn, magan sĩi agtha Ẽwandam iek khaugbam khʉʉnjöta nʉm.
Napem mʉchdëu ĩchab pãrag ẽsap phã deepʉ̈itarr gaai mua pãrag, “Jãg amach ʉʉin khabam dʉ̈ijã khapese aajem khʉʉn dʉ̈i chan oob khapeerkhamiet” a chirajim.

Pari mua mag chirʉm chan mag ar parhooba khapese aajem khʉʉn, wa phatkhon athee bĩe sĩerrjëem khʉʉn, nem jĩgmien wa nem parhoobamʉgta Ẽwandamagamjö jëeujem khʉʉn igwiata mag warre am dʉ̈i iekhajã iekhaba ni amag oobamjö abatjã aba chirajim. Mʉg jẽb gaai nʉweran ichiita am dʉ̈i maach ich jãg wënʉrraju.

Mua mag chirarran, ar pãach eepaijã ermanonaan anʉm khʉʉnta mag parhoobanaa phatkhon atheejã bĩe thʉnʉm khʉʉn, nem parhoobamʉgta ẽwandam awia jëeu nʉm khʉʉn, parhooba chikham khĩir iekhaajem khʉʉn, nag pig sĩerrjëem khʉʉn maimua nem jĩignemjã sĩerrjëem khʉʉnta jaau chirajim. Ar mag thʉnʉm khʉʉn dʉ̈i chan ni sĩi thach khoogpaijã oob am dʉ̈i ãba ohoodö amiet.

Chadcha ar sĩi ermanonaan khabam khʉʉn igwia chan pöd mua, “Aman magta sĩerrjëem” aju khaba chirʉm. Am mag jaaujuun ich Ẽwandamauta jaauju aai sim. Pari ichiita pãrau pãach eepaim khʉʉn dʉ̈in chadau pãachdëu khap nem inju aai nʉm. Magua mua pãrag, “Jãg pekau pöm sim warre pãach eemua chawag jʉrbapʉ̈it” a chirʉm.
